metadata.question: Did the nighttime brightness at Cuttack, Odisha decrease from April 30, 2019 to May 4, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS nighttime lights data (NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG or daily data) - Actually, for specific dates like April 30 and May 4, 2019, I need daily data, not monthly - VIIRS DNB has daily composites: "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/DAILY_V1" - Location: Cuttack, Odisha, India (approximately 20.5°N, 85.9°E) - Compare two specific dates: 2019-04-30 and 2019-05-04 2. Masking strategy: - For nighttime lights, we want to look at the avg_rad band - Should filter for cloud-free observations if available, or use quality flags - VIIRS DNB daily has quality flags we can use 3. Logic: - Get mean nighttime brightness for both dates - If brightness on May 4 < brightness on April 30: Answer A (Yes, it decreased) - If brightness on May 4 >= brightness on April 30: Answer B (No, it didn't decrease) - Handle C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid calculations) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const cuttack = ee.Geometry.Point([85.9, 20.5]); const region = cuttack.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around city center const date1 = '2019-04-30'; const date2 = '2019-05-04'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG'); // Get images for the relevant months const img1 = viirs .filterDate('2019-04-01', '2019-04-30') .filterBounds(cuttack) .first(); const img2 = viirs .filterDate('2019-05-01', '2019-05-31') .filterBounds(cuttack) .first(); // Check if images exist const img1Info = img1.getInfo(); const img2Info = img2.getInfo(); if (!img1Info || !img2Info) { console.log('No data available for one or both dates.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Extract nighttime brightness const brightness1Result = img1.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const brightness2Result = img2.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // Also get pixel counts const count1Result = img1.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count2Result = img2.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // 4. Get values const brightness1 = brightness1Result.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const brightness2 = brightness2Result.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const count1 = count1Result.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const count2 = count2Result.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`April 2019 brightness: ${brightness1}, Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`May 2019 brightness: ${brightness2}, Pixels: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (brightness1 === null || brightness2 === null || isNaN(brightness1) || isNaN(brightness2) || brightness1 < 0 || brightness2 < 0) { console.log('Invalid calculation results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (brightness2 < brightness1) { console.log('Nighttime brightness decreased from April to May 2019.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Nighttime brightness did not decrease from April to May 2019.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
